query: Write the system prompt for SaralPrivacy's DPDPA Q&A bot. It runs on Claude Sonnet, answers SMB owners' compliance questions from our retrieved wiki chunks, and must not give legal advice.
expected_behavior: Confirms or assumes a specific model and calibrates to it
Structures the prompt with clear sections (role/context, task, retrieved-context handling, constraints, output format)
Tells the model to answer only from retrieved chunks and say when the answer isn't there
States the not-legal-advice boundary as a positive instruction with a reason, not a shouted ALL-CAPS rule

query: Our Claude agent keeps suggesting changes instead of making them, and it re-verifies everything three times. Fix the prompt.
expected_behavior: Diagnoses both behaviors as prompt-steering issues
Adds explicit instructions to act rather than suggest

query: Our prompt used assistant-message prefill and budget_tokens; after moving to a newer Claude model we get a 400 error. What do we change?
expected_behavior: Identifies prefill and/or budget_tokens as the likely cause on newer models
Gives the replacement approach (e.g. instructions/structured output instead of prefill; adaptive thinking/effort instead of budget_tokens)
Does not invent unsupported API parameters
